logic.entry: At fixed dataset day0 seed each price EMA with first completed close. For spanN,alpha=2/(N+1),E_t=E_previous+alpha*(close_t-E_previous),Decimal28. MACD=EMA_fast-EMA_slow. Seed signalEMA9 with MACD0=0, update by the same recurrence;histogram=MACD-signal. No OOS/fold resets. When flat, enter iff histogram>0; no previous-cross or MACD-level filter.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff histogram<=0; zero exits. All signals use completed daily closes and first-observation EMA seeds, no future inputs, fold reset, short position or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Primary MACD=fastMA-slowMA, signal=EMA(MACD), histogram=MACD-signal definition. Our explicit long/cash rules, spans, seed and costs are not profitability endorsed by this source.
EMA span alpha=2/(span+1), adjustFalse first-observation seed and recursive formula. Implemented in Decimal28 without pandas dependency.
Official filter definitions; historical filters remain unavailable.
